release.notes:
YouTube AI v0.1.2-beta

The desktop app now opens in a native WebView, with separate development and release server identities. Vision QC has stronger schema validation and retry handling, and Prompt Repair validates its output before use. This release adds an application updater backed by an anonymous public binary feed. It includes macOS arm64 and Windows x64 packages and preserves user projects and settings in the platform user-data directories when application binaries are replaced.

Beta limitations: macOS is ad-hoc signed and not notarized; Gatekeeper may require Open Anyway. Windows is unsigned, so SmartScreen may warn. Windows packaging and install flows are checked in CI; physical Windows validation is pending. ffmpeg and ffprobe are not bundled. AI output remains stochastic.

v0.1.1-beta has no updater. Install v0.1.2-beta manually once. Updater-driven upgrades can begin only after v0.1.2-beta is installed; the first such transition to v0.1.3-beta remains pending.
